name: embedding-smoke
run:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, sys, time, urllib.request

OLLAMA = 'http://127.0.0.1:11434'
MODEL = 'nomic-embed-text'
out = os.path.join(os.environ['GAP_OUT'], 'embedding-smoke.json')

# no-pull guard: gap packs may use a RESIDENT model only — installs and
# pulls are forbidden, so refuse fast instead of letting ollama fetch.
try:
    tags = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(
        OLLAMA + '/api/tags', timeout=10).read().decode())
except Exception as e:
    sys.exit(f'ollama unreachable ({e}) — resident model required')
models = [m.get('name', '') for m in tags.get('models', [])]
if not any(m == MODEL or m.startswith(MODEL + ':') for m in models):
    sys.exit(f'{MODEL} not resident (have {models}) — refusing to pull')

texts = [f'gap smoke document {i}: Ada Nest lane routing and verification'
         for i in range(10)]
t = time.time()
req = urllib.request.Request(OLLAMA + '/api/embed',
    data=json.dumps({'model': MODEL, 'input': texts}).encode(),
    headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'})
d = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=90).read().decode())
vecs = d.get('embeddings') or []
json.dump({'model': MODEL, 'documents': len(texts),
           'dimensions': len(vecs[0]) if vecs else 0,
           'seconds': round(time.time() - t, 3),
           'production_mutation': 'none — writes only under gap-packs/<name>/out'},
          open(out, 'w'), indent=1)
print('wrote', out)
PY
